author: Ryan J. Woosley
sample_context: Atlantic surface seawater collected 2019-10-10 at 39 degrees 46.406 minutes N, 70 degrees 53.065 minutes W. Seawater was subsequently modified in a laboratory experiment. These values do not describe the original ocean pH.
data_level: Published absorbances, not raw detector currents. Subtract A730 from A578 and A434, then calculate R. raw_pHt is BEFORE indicator perturbation correction. Do not present it as unperturbed seawater pH.
temperature: Use Calculated_Temperature = 25.001 degrees C as specified by the dataset for the pH calculation. Measured_Temperature records individual readings (24.978, 24.996, 25.011, 24.982 degrees C). No additional temperature correction is inferred.
method: Purified m-cresol purple, Agilent 8454, Liu et al. (2011), DOI 10.1021/es200665d, eqs 18 and 19. Validity 20 <= S <= 40, 278.15 <= T <= 308.15 K.
rounding: Calculate from published absorbances without rounding intermediates, then round pH to four decimals. Coefficients in the article worked substitution are rounded for display only.
